Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. Exterior commissioning scope seam (the brief's wording question). The amount's trigger is the ladder ("on a line that calls for whole-line work", defined by break count > 0 and the most recent completed repair within the lookback), while the third overwrite retires A6 "for the acceptance camera inspection of a sewer lateral replaced whole". Both phrases are verbatim source text and the KB carries both verbatim (commissioning doc; A6 note). On the visible surface the number has one reading — the ladder decides the contribution; "replaced whole" names the inspection carved out of A6. The residual seam is the source's: a sewer lateral replaced whole whose records do not meet the whole-line test (or one meeting the test whose approved work is a section repair) falls between the retirement's scope and the ladder's trigger, since the factor test (most recent completed repair in the lookback) is not the same measure as A3's prior-breaks count. Not triggered in either task (task 1 is a water line); recorded for the policy layer, not as a KB defect.
2. BLUEPRINT-KNOWN base-vs-base cancellation effective-date conflict (base frozen): outside this closure; not re-judged.
